title: Strong Teammate Wall
intro: Create a shared classroom display of what makes a strong teammate.

blocks.text: Choose one slip size and print one slip per student, or select the size in the Print Pack Builder.

items.title: Show
items.text: Display Slide 8 to introduce the Strong Teammate Wall.

items.title: Respond
items.text: Students complete “A strong teammate is someone who…” on their slips.

items.title: Display
items.text: Collect and display the responses together as a class Strong Teammate Wall.
